walkable_threshold.foot_support_note: The authored sill remains visible walkable ground. Its local surface is above the terrain mesh. The body-band top includes its conservative maximum height; primary collision projection remains z=0.
walkable_threshold.scope_note: Exempts low threshold horizontal faces and connecting risers only in the actual portal; retains low wall-leg footprint elsewhere. No blanket removal of the gate foundation.

limits: Fixed shadows and original object-to-object occlusion are baked. Do not arbitrarily move or remove props using this set.
Ground layer includes fixed shadows, small decorative rubble and the complete gate threshold.
Tree branches, shrubs, ferns and grass have no new collision.
Foliage banks share one sorting anchor; within-bank interleaving is approximate.
2 completely hidden props retain empty-alpha source layers and collision metadata, but should be skipped for drawing.
Collision points use z=0 ground-plane projection. True terrain and sill heights are preserved separately in collisions.json.
